THE WAVING.CA BUYING GUIDES

Choosing a flag: size, fabric & finishing

Start with where the flag will fly, how it attaches and when you need it. Those details make the choice clearer.

IN THIS GUIDE

What size flag do I need?Which fabric should I consider?Which finishing will fit?What belongs in a flag quote?

What size flag do I need?

Choose a flag that fits both the design’s proportions and the pole’s approved flag capacity. Measure an existing flag from the ground when it is safely lowered; pole height alone is not a load rating.

Canada’s National Flag uses a 2:1 length-to-height ratio. Canadian Heritage gives these examples for exterior permanent poles:

Flag: height × lengthPole height
0.90 × 1.80 m5.10–6 m
1.40 × 2.80 m9–10.50 m
1.80 × 3.60 m12–13.50 m

These are display proportions, not engineering approval or a list of stocked sizes. Confirm the pole manufacturer’s limits, site exposure and attachment system before ordering.

Reference: Canadian Heritage: flying the National Flag

Which fabric should I consider?

Nylon is generally lighter and moves readily in a light breeze. Two-ply spun polyester is often considered for more exposed, continuous displays. The fabric construction matters as much as the material name.

Option to discussWhat to confirm
NylonFabric weight, outdoor suitability, colour treatment and edge finishing.
Two-ply spun polyesterSuitability for your exposure and compatibility with the pole’s flag capacity.
Printed custom fabricExact fabric, print method, viewing sides and intended indoor or outdoor use.

Availability and specifications are confirmed in the quote. No fabric has a guaranteed lifespan in every location.

Reference: Annin Flagmakers: outdoor fabric characteristics

Which finishing will fit?

Match the flag’s attachment to the existing hardware. A heading with grommets, a sleeve and a rope heading are different specifications; they should not be treated as interchangeable.

  • Send a close-up of the existing attachment, taken safely from ground level.
  • For a sleeve, confirm the pole diameter and required sleeve opening.
  • For custom flags, specify whether the reverse may show a mirrored image or needs a separately readable design.

What belongs in a flag quote?

  • Flag design, quantity and dimensions, or a photo of the existing display.
  • Indoor or outdoor use, location and approximate pole height.
  • Preferred delivery date and any approved custom artwork.

A useful quote identifies the material, size, finish, quantity, delivery arrangements and any artwork work. Compare those details alongside the total price.
